title: Get to know Sales
summary: Tour of Quotes, Invoices, Payments, Payment Methods and Services: what each screen is for.

steps.title: Sales
steps.details: This section has 5 screens; we'll go through them one by one.

steps.title: Quotes
steps.details: The treatment plan with prices for the patient to approve; once confirmed it's invoiced, booked and charged. It has 9 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Invoices
steps.details: What the patient is charged: it comes from a confirmed quote, a quick payment or is entered directly. It has 8 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Payments
steps.details: Payments from patients: invoice payments and prepayments (money on account that's later applied to invoices). It has 5 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Payment Methods
steps.details: They're chosen on each payment. Cash equivalents count toward the cash count. It has 5 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Services
steps.details: They're chosen when booking, quoting and invoicing. The duration sets the appointment length; services with a workflow have steps (sessions). It has 6 guides in «Guide me on this screen».
